context: A uni student gives his teen friend honest career advice
purpose: Teach: あがっ/だす/云う/反面/誇る/著しく/僅か/満たす

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: レンくん、進路のことで相談していい？最近、成績が著しく下がっててマジで焦ってる。
lines.en: Ren, can I talk to you about my career path? My grades have dropped markedly lately and I'm seriously panicking.
lines.style: Worried teen voice, slightly rushed and vulnerable tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: もちろん。云うまでもないけど、進路で迷う時期だよね。正直に話すよ。
lines.en: Of course. Needless to say, this is the age where everyone gets lost about their path. I'll be honest with you.
lines.style: Calm older-brother tone, measured and sincere delivery

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 私、デザインの道に進みたいの。でも親は、もっと安定した仕事に就きなさいって。
lines.en: I want to go into design. But my parents keep saying I should get a more stable job.
lines.style: Conflicted teen voice, slight frustration showing through

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: デザインは楽しい反面、最初の数年は収入が僅かなことも多いのが現実なんだ。
lines.en: Design is fun, but on the flip side, the first few years often bring only meager income — that's reality.
lines.style: Honest mentor tone, gentle but firm with truth

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やっぱり…。でも好きなことやりたい気持ちが急にこみあがってきちゃって。
lines.en: I knew it... But my urge to do what I love has suddenly welled up inside me.
lines.style: Wavering teen voice, half excited half scared

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ両方の条件を満たす形を考えよう。バイトしながら、夜にポートフォリオを作りだすとかさ。
lines.en: Then let's think of a way to satisfy both conditions. Like working part-time while starting to build a portfolio at night.
lines.style: Practical advisor tone, problem-solving and constructive

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: そっか、両立できる道もあるんだね。一気に決めなくていいんだ、ちょっと気が楽になった。
lines.en: Right, there are paths where I can balance both. I don't have to decide everything at once — I feel a bit lighter.
lines.style: Relieved teen voice, slowly regaining confidence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そう。誰もが誇るような作品なんて、いきなり作れないからね。少しずつでいいよ。
lines.en: Exactly. Nobody makes work that everyone boasts about right away. Little by little is fine.
lines.style: Encouraging closing tone, warm and reassuring
